shortDescription: Configures DNS lookup on Windows hosts

options.name: adapter_names
options.description: Adapter name or list of adapter names for which to manage DNS settings ('*' is supported as a wildcard value). The adapter name used is the connection caption in the Network Control Panel or the InterfaceAlias of C(Get-DnsClientServerAddress).

options.name: dns_servers
options.description: Single or ordered list of DNS servers (IPv4 and IPv6 addresses) to configure for lookup. An empty list will configure the adapter to use the DHCP-assigned values on connections where DHCP is enabled, or disable DNS lookup on statically-configured connections. IPv6 DNS servers can only be set on Windows Server 2012 or newer, older hosts can only set IPv4 addresses.

options.name: suffix_search_list
options.description: Specifies a list of global suffixes that can be used in the specified order by the DNS client for resolving the IP address.
